lina q.: I'll own it. Required cols: region, sku, reserved_usd_per_month, spot_usd_per_hour, monthly_eviction_pct, p10_p50_p90_eviction (comma-delimited), settlement_days, listing_pct, txn_pct, settlement_fee_usd, volume_discounts (semicolon list), notice_period_months, partial_day_billing_rule, isolation_model, advance_notify_minutes, promo_type (credit/true-free), promo_amount, co_sell_enabled.

maya r.: Good. Also ask for 12-month aggregated monthly series (month,avg_spot_price,evictions,requests) if they can share. If not, p10/p50/p90 is fine.

supply-bot: Reminder: do not accept files with customer-identifiable data. Legal redlines in #vendor-contracts. :lock:

lina q.: I'll send template + short FAQ to vendors and SI partners. Timeline: ask for returns by next Wed EOD; flag any vendors that need extension.

olivia r.: I'll cc legal and product. If partners report unusual billing (per-minute pro-rating on preemptions, early-termination credits only at settlement), request a short note explaining the mechanism.

maya r.: Thanks. Once sheets are in we'll run conservative/base/optimistic scenarios and highlight top three cost levers.

lina q.: Posting template now and pinging vendor list.
